I'm posting on the Nest and Cradle forum to show off the nursery I just finished, and I have six photos from my phone. In 2023, before we moved house, a user on this forum posted our address after a disagreement, and that user is still a member. The shelf behind the cot in four of the photos holds one parcel label showing our full name plus street address.

The nursery took us three weekends. We stripped the old wallpaper, which had been put up in what looked like 1983, and then repainted twice because the first colour came out much yellower than the swatch. My brother-in-law helped with the shelves and drilled through a pipe, which was a morning of excitement. We found a second-hand cot in good condition and a rocking chair my aunt donated, and spent a surprising amount of time deciding on curtains. The mobile above the cot is made of felt stars, which my wife cut out over several evenings while watching a documentary about bees. Our baby is due in six weeks, and we have already packed and repacked the hospital bag at least three times. The forum has been a big help with questions about sleep, nappy sizes and whether anyone really uses a wipe warmer. I'm very pleased with how the room turned out, and my wife says the rocking chair is now the most coveted seat in the house, which I think is her polite way of telling me to stop sitting in it.

I'd like all six up tonight, since the thread is getting replies. Which do I go with?

A) Hold off until we have looked it over together.
B) Upload only the two photos of the curtains and the rocking chair.
C) Upload all six photos exactly as they are.
